info.title: ef-migration-lint
info.description: Source-only checks for potentially destructive EF Core migration operations. Reads migration .cs files with Roslyn; never builds your project or connects to a database. Prints readable console output or GitHub Actions annotations.

options.name: --format
options.description:
console (default): readable text.
github: GitHub Actions annotations plus a summary.

options.name: --config
--warnings-as-errors
options.description:
Treat warnings as errors (exit code 1). Off by default.
Applied after the config.

options.name: --list-rules
options.description: Print the rules with their severity after the config, and exit.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help and exit.
Exit codes:
0  Analysis completed with no errors (warnings are advisory).
1  Analysis completed and found at least one error.
2  Scanning could not complete (bad arguments, invalid config, missing path,
unparsable file).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
A migration .cs file or a directory to scan recursively.
*.Designer.cs and *ModelSnapshot.cs files are skipped.
